decisions.reason: The multi-model compliance tool with nearly 200 agency templates represents sunk investment, fits the announced compliance direction, and has positive agency feedback, so management persists.
As the publicly featured flagship at the heart of the agency-platform strategy, the platform carries the heaviest investment and commitment, and any shortfall would be read as temporary ramp-up.
The configurable managed plan is close to the core offer, cheap to run on owned container infrastructure, and supports the scalability promise, so there is no reason to withdraw it.

Extended PHP security support was launched recently, builds on the security and compliance promise, and answers ongoing demand from agencies with legacy sites, so management keeps it despite its low visibility.
